concerns: Reading 19: 歩兵 is read as ふひょう. While 歩 can be ふ in some contexts (like 将棋の歩), the standard reading for 歩兵 (infantry) is ほへい. ふひょう is not a common or standard reading for 歩兵 in this context. The note "— note the differ" suggests it might be trying to highlight a difference, but ふひょう itself is not a standard reading for 歩兵.
